chunks: A number of sons were born to me, and I used to write and ask for supplication, but nothing would be written back to me concerning them, so they all died.
Then when al-Ḥasan, my son, was born to me, I wrote asking for supplication, and I received the reply: 'He will remain,' and all praise is due to Allah.

key_terms.أُجِبْتُ: I was answered; I received a reply

ai.seo_question: How does this narration describe the effect of the Imam’s du'a regarding the survival of a child?
ai.summary: Al-Qāsim ibn al-ʿAlāʾ relates that several of his sons died after he had written seeking du'a for them but received no reply concerning them. When al-Ḥasan was born, he again wrote seeking du'a and was answered that the child would remain, and the son survived by the permission of Allah.
